description.fun: The puffy crest on Panpour's head stores nutrient-rich water, and plants watered with it grow large. It sprays the water from its tail to water plants or to keep itself damp, since it can't thrive in dry places. Made with its siblings for the Striaton City Gym's restaurant, it plays 'see no evil' of the three wise monkeys with its eyes closed, and it may be a visual pun on Sea-Monkeys.
description.guide: Panpour is a Water-type monkey Pokémon and one of the three elemental monkeys, with Pansage and Pansear. It stores nutrient-rich water in the crest on its head and sprays it from its tail. It evolves into Simipour with a Water Stone.
description.tagline: A water monkey whose head tuft makes plants grow big.

description.fun: Simipour siphons up water with its tail to refill the tufts on its head, then blasts it out at a pressure strong enough to destroy a concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water. Its locks echo the hippie hairstyles of the late 1960s and 70s, and keeping water on its head recalls the kappa of Japanese folklore. It's the sign for February in the Unova horoscope.
description.guide: Simipour is the evolved form of Panpour, a Water-type monkey that stores water in the tufts on its head. It refills them by siphoning water with its tail and can shoot high-pressure jets strong enough to break concrete.
description.tagline: A shaggy-haired water monkey with a wall-smashing jet.
